verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance is a SaaS compliance platform with a public OAuth-secured REST API, so webhook event subscriptions are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence, however, documents only request/response API features (client credentials, rate limits, idempotency keys, registered-agent-deliveries read endpoints). It shows no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Phone notifications for service of process and user-customizable annual report reminders are adjacent notification features, not webhooks, and earn no credit.
